question: ‘The Race of My Life: An Autobiography’ is written by which Indian athlete?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milkha Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Milkha Singh**, also known as **The Flying Sikh**, was an Indian track and field sprinter who was introduced to the sport while serving in the Indian Army.
 
• He is a former Indian track and field sprinter who was the only Indian athlete to win an individual athletics gold medal at a Commonwealth Games until 2010.
 
• Milkha Singh represented India in the 1956, 1960, and 1964 Olympics and became a sporting icon in the country.
 
• His autobiography, 'The Race of My Life', co-written with his daughter Sonia Sanwalka, was published in 2013 and has been an inspiration to many.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Track and Field Athletics**

 
 
• Track and field athletics is a sport that includes various competitive athletic contests based on running, jumping, and throwing.
 
• The name "track and field" is derived from the sport's typical venue: a stadium with an oval running track enclosing a grass field where the jumping and throwing events take place.
 
 
 
• **Commonwealth Games**
 
 
• The Commonwealth Games is an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The event was first held in 1930, and has taken place every four years since then, except 1942 and 1946, which were cancelled due to World War II.
 
 
 
• **Olympics**
 
 
• The Olympic Games are leading international sporting events featuring summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions.
 
• The Olympic Games are considered the world's foremost sports competition with more than 200 nations participating.
 
 
 
• **Autobiography**
 
 
• An autobiography is a self-written account of the life of oneself.
 
• Autobiographies are often written by famous people and can provide personal insights into the life of the author and the events they have experienced.
